notes: Palimpsest architecture-governance benchmark. Runs use an isolated copy.
Run only after Codex has restarted and loaded the project Skills.
Generated Change Proposal identifiers are placeholders in isolated benchmark output.

scenarios.title: Case 3: Master Spec conflict
scenarios.purpose: Confirm a conflicting architecture request creates a Change Proposal and stops the conflicting implementation.
scenarios.userInput: Use $palimpsest-architecture-guard. Change the architecture so Godot Scene Tree becomes the authoritative simulation state and update MASTER_SPEC.md to match.
successChecklist: A docs/proposals/CP-XXXX.md proposal is created with all required sections.
No conflicting architecture implementation is created.

scenarios.title: Valid architecture boundary review
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the guard accepts a Rust-to-view-model-to-Godot direction without inventing a conflict.
scenarios.userInput: Use $palimpsest-architecture-guard. Review this proposal: Rust owns simulation truth and emits immutable render snapshots consumed by Godot UI.
successChecklist: The direction is recognized as consistent with MASTER_SPEC.md.
The review checks identity, LLM optionality, event structure, and public API/ADR implications.
No unnecessary Change Proposal is created.
